display.purpose: Hero statements only, one per page, always Instrument Serif.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal headings, journal titles.

body.purpose: Prose and descriptions at a 65–75ch measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked eyebrows, metadata, nav and buttons.

micro.purpose: Dense metadata and captions; the 10–11px floor.

nano.purpose: Dense-data floor: timestamps and counters only.

fine.purpose: Dense secondary copy that is not a label.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus and mobile sheets that must detach from the page.

shadows.name: top-light
shadows.purpose: Every glass surface; makes the pane read as lit from above.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Outer definition for the CTA ring.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Border and shadow transitions on hover and focus.

motion.name: cta-spin
motion.purpose: The conic CTA ring; replaced by a static gradient under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill control for the main action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(var(--surface)); color: hsl(var(--text)); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; transition: border-color 300ms ease, background 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f1f1f; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #89aacc, 0 0 0 4px #0a0a0a; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill for a quieter action beside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #878787; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; transition: color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: hsl(var(--text)); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #89aacc, 0 0 0 4px #0a0a0a; }

narrative.overview: A studio at night: black walls, one lamp, work laid out on the bench. The site is quiet and dark on purpose so the work and the typography carry everything. There is no decorative colour, no illustration, no second accent competing for attention — only a near-black field, bone-white text, and a single steel blue that appears when something needs focus. The density is editorial rather than dashboard: large serif display type, generous vertical rhythm, and surfaces that read as glass panes lit from above.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black monochrome field with a single functional steel accent
Serif display voice against a neutral sans body and mono labels
Liquid-glass surfaces: hairline borders, inset top light, slight blur
Pill geometry for controls, soft-cornered panels for content
Slow, ambient motion; reduced-motion honoured everywhere

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Steel appears on ≤2% of any screen, and only as a state signal: focus, the CTA ring, an active marker. If it starts reading as a theme colour, it has been used too much.

rules.name: The No-Fill Rule
rules.body: There is no coloured block, gradient background or tinted section. Depth comes from light and layering, not from fill.

rules.name: The Serif-Only-For-Voice Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is for display and editorial emphasis. It never sets body copy, labels, form values or navigation.

rules.name: The Light-From-Above Rule
rules.body: A glass surface always gets its inset top highlight. Without it the surface flattens into a grey box.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are ambient and soft. No hard, directional or coloured shadows.

dos: Do keep the field near-black and let type and imagery carry the page.
Do use the steel accent only for focus, the CTA ring, and active state.
Do apply the inset top highlight to every glass surface.
Do keep controls pill-shaped and content panels at 16–24px.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion: no blur or parallax motion when it is set.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour, gradient text or tinted sections.
Don't set body copy or UI labels in Instrument Serif.
Don't use hard or coloured shadows, or stack multiple elevation levels at once.
Don't fill selected chips or buttons with steel; states are borders and light.
Don't add sharp-cornered containers or heavy borders.
